verdict.rationale: Zero is an AI email client, so shared team inboxes are a fair question for it. The evidence only shows a single-user 'Unified Inbox' that combines one person's multiple provider accounts. There is no documentation of shared accounts, team channels, or synchronized conversation state across team members.

support.subject: As a team-lead, my team works shared inboxes together — shared accounts or team channels where everyone sees the same conversation state
